lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a 2D spatial arrangement that transitions from high density near the head to a more structured grid pattern on the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a light-reflecting upper edge and a shadowed lower boundary.
